name: Virginia Envirothon
org: Virginia Association of Soil and Water Conservation Districts
what_you_do: Teams of five high school students are tested on soil, forests, wildlife, water life and a current issue. The tests are at field stations. Teams also give a talk.
who_can_apply: High school students on a team of five with one adult coach or chaperone. The page says high school students but gives no grade range.
pay_detail: No fee is mentioned on the program page.
deadline_text: Page says to contact your local district by winter for spring local or regional contests. The 2027 state contest is listed for May 16 to 17 at Roanoke College. Area I competes April 27, 2027. Area II competes April 22, 2027. Other areas were not posted as of Nov 4, 2026. The top three teams from each of six areas advance.
how_to_apply: Contact your local Soil and Water Conservation District. If you do not know it, email byron.minson@vaswcd.org.
notes: As of Nov 4, 2026, dates for Areas III to VI were not posted. Check the Current Competition page on the same site.
